property_summary: For every ERC-165 interface id, the reference contract's supportsInterface returns true for both IERC165 and IAccessControl ids (and false otherwise), but the buggy version drops the AccessControl interface support so supportsInterface(IAccessControl) becomes false, violating the invariant that a contract claiming IAccessControl support answers true for its own interface id.
change_summary: Return only the superclass ERC165 result, dropping the AccessControl interface support so supportsInterface(IAccessControl) becomes false.
